coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 6 variable categories at a semantic level: Docta as the fixed cleaning framework, raw versus Docta-cleaned training data, and F1-based predictive performance.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed Anthropic Harmless and Red Team datasets with an unspecified dataset family; substitutes a frozen encoder with a linear head for the BERT/GPT-2 model comparison; and evaluates ChatGPT–human disagreement cases against alternative labels instead of the specified ChatGPT Cleaned and Human Sampled test subsets. The F1 metric is retained, but the toxicity-classification task and Tables 6–7 context are missing.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that Docta-cleaned training data should significantly improve F1 on both specified evaluation subsets, supporting improved label credibility through reduced label inconsistencies.
